label: Core Architecture & Components
desc: 8 interview questions covering Fundamentals, Architecture, Use Cases.

subs.label: Fundamentals
subs.desc: Apache Flume is a distributed, reliable, and available service for efficiently collecting, aggregating, and moving large amounts of log data from many different sources to a centralized data store — most commonly Hadoop.

subs.label: Architecture
subs.desc: An Agent is a process that hosts Flume components such as sources, channels, and sinks, and thus has the ability to receive, store, and forward events to their destination.

subs.label: Use Cases
subs.desc: Why Flume? Why are we using Flume?

subs.label: Channels
subs.desc: The FILE channel is the most reliable channel among the three (JDBC, FILE, and MEMORY), because it writes events to disk before acknowledging them.

subs.label: Reliability
subs.desc: Yes — Apache Flume provides end-to-end reliability because of its transactional approach to data flow.

label: Sinks, Integrations & Data Flow
desc: 8 interview questions covering Sinks, Extensibility, Data Flow, Configuration and more.

subs.label: Sinks
subs.desc: The major difference is where the events end up: HDFS FileSink writes events into the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS), whereas FileRollSink stores events into the local file system.

subs.label: Extensibility
subs.desc: Does Apache Flume provide support for third-party plugins?

subs.label: Data Flow
subs.desc: Can Flume distribute data to multiple destinations? How can a multi-hop agent be set up in Flume?

subs.label: Configuration
subs.desc: Can you explain configuration files in Flume?

subs.label: Integrations
subs.desc: Is it possible to leverage real-time analysis on the big data collected by Flume directly?

subs.label: Ecosystem
subs.desc: What is Flume-NG? What are the data extraction tools in Hadoop?

subs.label: Configuration
subs.desc: Flume processes streaming data, so once started there is no stop/end to the process — it asynchronously flows data from source to HDFS via an agent.
